_info: Weekly calendar (Madrid time). Slot A = 06:00, B = 11:00, C = 18:00 (Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat). Edit here to change what goes out each day; Make only says which slot it is.
_games: Games: stop = 'Stop the video', hl = 'Higher or Lower', cup = 'World Cup of countries' (Saturday 18:00, one match per week; votes = comments on the previous match).
_decision: 28 Oct 2026, from week-1 data: photo carousels reach ~1 person on Instagram -> versus and week removed, top20 goes out as a reel (video). Rankings (top10/top20), maps and races get the most views; 'stat' (big gap) and 'guess' were the weakest -> replaced. Review again after 2 more weeks.
